children: LiPower New Energy, a China-based energy storage battery maker incorporated in the Cayman Islands, filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol LPNE. The company plans to offer 5,000,000 ordinary shares at an expected price range of $5.00 to $6.00 per share, implying a deal size of up to $30 million. Proceeds are earmarked for marketing, R&D, and working capital.

LiPower New Energy designs, manufactures, and sells portable, residential, commercial and industrial energy storage systems, as well as photovoltaic‑integrated storage products. Operating through its Shenzhen subsidiary, the company focuses on lithium‑ion batteries and battery management systems (BMS), serving OEM/ODM customers globally and holding certifications including CE, UL, PSE, FCC, ROHS, UN38.3, and BSCI.

The company targets multiple revenue streams: sales of energy storage batteries to system integrators and enterprises, consumer electronics batteries, and monetization of proprietary technologies via patent licensing and technology transfers. LiPower emphasizes R&D, with over half of its workforce in research roles and a portfolio of patent applications, and plans to use IPO proceeds to accelerate product development and market expansion.
: Growing global demand for portable, residential, and grid energy storage alongside renewables adoption.
: Industry associations project strong shipment growth in portable energy storage through 2026 with multi‑billion yuan market size.
: OEM/ODM supplier with international certifications and export footprint across the U.S., Japan, UK, Germany, and Australia.
: CATL, BYD, Ganfeng Lithium, QuantumScape, Solid Power, Toyota, Samsung SDI, ProLogium.
: Shift toward solid‑state batteries for higher energy density, safety, and fast charging; expanding applications in EVs, consumer electronics, and grid storage.
: Preferred OEM/ODM partner to multiple international brands
: Headquarters in Shenzhen, China; U.S. subsidiary Wattlabs Int’l
: Exports to the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom, Germany, Australia, and other countries
: Strategic cooperation with Wattlabs INC; preparing channel entry into Costco, Lowe’s, Walmart, Supercheap, Bunnings Warehouse, and Total Tools
: ~46 employees with >50% in R&D; ~80% of team with 10+ years’ experience; 60 patent applications (2 invention, 21 utility models, 10 design); multiple international certifications
: Management states 2026 revenue from energy storage products is expected to exceed US$20 million
, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer - Founder-leader since 2019 with industry strategy and compliance background; oversees long‑term planning and execution.
, Director and Chief Marketing Officer - ~20 years in electronic precision manufacturing; led international market development and strategic customer growth.
, Director and Chief Operating Officer - 23 years in electronic engineering and operations; prior executive roles in Taiwanese and Hong Kong‑funded enterprises.
, Chief Financial Officer - Experienced finance leader with expertise in tax, budgeting, financial analysis, and capital planning.
, Chief Technology Officer - 25 years in new energy and technology; previous roles at Huawei and leadership in energy storage R&D and operations.
: 40% marketing and promotion, 40% technology R&D, 20% working capital
